# Lucide icons

The Dashboard's shared icon adapter uses icons from [lucide-react 1.45.0](https://www.npmjs.com/package/lucide-react/v/1.45.0). The [upstream license notice](LICENSE) accompanies this distribution and covers Lucide's ISC license and the MIT-licensed Feather icons it incorporates. Keep that notice with copies of the icons and in any separately distributed bundle that includes them.
